login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to access your youth circles, events calendar, and mentorship notes.
login.firstTimeNoticeDesc: Enter the temporary password sent to your phone via WhatsApp or your registered email address.
login.identifierHelper: Enter your registered fellowship telephone number or email address.
login.passwordPlaceholder: Enter your password or temporary code
login.keepSignedIn: Keep me signed in on this device

setup.title: Create Permanent Password
setup.welcome: Welcome, <1>{{name}}</1>. Please set a new permanent password to activate your account.
setup.sessionTimedOutDesc: For security, temporary setup sessions are limited to 15 minutes. Please sign in again with your temporary password.
setup.successDesc: Your account is now fully active. Redirecting to your dashboard...
setup.notice: Once activated, your temporary password will be permanently disabled.

forgotPassword.title: Reset Your Password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your registered phone number or email address. We'll send you a 6-digit verification code to help you regain access.
forgotPassword.identifierHelper: Accepts official fellowship contact lines or email address.
forgotPassword.contactLeader: Contact your community animator or leader

verifyOtp.title: Verify Your Identity
verifyOtp.subtitle: Enter the single-use six digit code sent to your registered channel.

resetPassword.title: Set New Password
resetPassword.subtitle: Create a fresh, secure password for <1>{{identifier}}</1>. All previous active sessions will be safely terminated.
resetPassword.tokenExpiredDesc: For your safety, password reset tokens expire after 15 minutes.
resetPassword.successDesc: Your credentials have been safely updated. You can now sign in using your new password.

changePassword.title: Change Password
changePassword.subtitle: Update your password to preserve the safety of your account.
changePassword.reusedWarning: New password must be different from your current password.
changePassword.successDesc: Your new password is now active. Closing window...

sessionTerminated.title: Session Terminated for Security
sessionTerminated.desc: A security irregularity or session expiration was detected. To protect your personal information, all active sessions on this device have been signed out.
sessionTerminated.auditTag: Security Event Logged • Session Refresh Required

accountRevoked.title: Account Access Suspended
accountRevoked.desc: Your account access has been revoked or suspended by a community administrator. You have been safely logged out. Please reach out to your local coordinator or fellowship leader to resolve this.
